title: Fix leftover references and dead code in scripts and tests
body:
- tree_status.sh still told people to sync vendor.conf, which the project stopped using years ago.
- xref-helpmsgs-manpages documented a -n/--dry-run option that was never implemented (it would die as "Unknown option"), and carried a LibPod:: package name copied over from podman.
- Makefile test-unit-local greps out a vendor/.* pattern that go list ./... never produces in module mode.
- 050-signing.bats printed an empty $expected_rc in its diagnostic (run_skopeo sets it to "" for '?'); use the actual expected value 0.
